title: Bhutan New Year Special Tour | Group Departure
highlights: Discover Bhutan's unique blend of traditions and modernity as you explore Phuntsholing's landscapes, Thimphu's cultural sites, and Paro's serene beauty on a wonderful vacation.
Walk across Bhutan’s longest suspension bridge, Punakha Bridge built in traditional Bhutanese design and offering views of the confluence of Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu rivers.
Visit the Buddha Dordenma, a stunning statue standing 51.5m tall, making it one of the largest Buddha statues in the world, symbolising peace and enlightenment.
Hike to the sacred grounds of the stunning Tiger's Nest Monastery, where Guru Padmasambhava is believed to have meditated and spread Buddhism.
Ascend to Chelela Pass, Bhutan's highest motorable pass, perched on an elevation of 3,988m, offering views of the Himalayan peaks, including Jhomolhari and Jichu Drake.
inclusions: Transfer from Bagdogra International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
2 nights stay in Phuntsholing with breakfast and lunch or dinner
2 nights stay in Thimphu City with breakfast and lunch or dinner
2 nights stay in Paro with breakfast and lunch or dinner
Transfer from Bhutan Immigration Office   to Bagdogra International Airport
Daily Government Royalties and Taxes (INR 1200 per person per night)
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
Tips and Gratuities: Driver, Guide, and Hotel Staff
Entrance fees of all sightseeing places to be visited
know_before_you_go: Ensure you have an original valid passport (with at least 6 months of validity) or an original voter ID. If traveling with a child under 18, bring their original birth certificate.
Be prepared for any expenses arising from natural calamities (like landslides or road blockages) or political disturbances (such as strikes). These costs will need to be paid directly on the spot.
Any additional sightseeing or extra vehicle usage not listed in the itinerary will be at customers own expense.
An experienced, certified English/Hindi-speaking tour guide will accompany you in Bhutan.
A tourist SIM card will be provided upon arrival in Bhutan.
Any increase in taxes or fuel prices may lead to additional costs for surface transportation and land arrangements prior to departure.
If unexpected events like natural disasters or road blockages occur, any additional costs will need to be covered by the customer and paid directly at the time.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of a similar standard.
Any breakage or damage of any items at the property will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bagdogra | Transfer to Phuntsholing | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bagdogra! Upon your arrival at the airport, get driven to Phuntsholing. After you reach, check in at the hotel. You can relax for the day or explore the town at your leisure. You may visit Zangto Pelri, dedicated to Guru Padmasambhava, a holy figure in Tibetan Buddhism or explore Phuentsholing Market, featuring a variety of goods, from traditional Bhutanese handicrafts to fresh produce and spices. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Swift Dzire, Wagon R or similar
items.desc: Wagon R, Swift Dzire or similar will be Provided

days.title: Transfer to Thimphu | Enroute Visit to Kharbandi Gompa Monastery
days.desc: Begin the day by completing immigration formalities to travel in Bhutan officially. After the procedures, get driven to Thimphu. Enroute, stop at Kharbandi Gompa, which houses magnificent statues of the Bhutanese deities of Shakyamuni Buddha and offers views of Phuentsholing and West Bengal. Next, pass Chukha town, famed for its subtropical forests and rich cultural heritage. Continue towards Thimphu. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Punakha via Dochula Pass
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Punakha. Enroute, stop at Dochula Pass & admire its 108 chortens. Continue to Punakha & upon arrival, explore Punakha Dzong, located between Pho Chhu & Mo Chhu rivers. Next, walk across Bhutan’s longest suspension bridge, Punakha Bridge, offering city views. Then, visit Chimi Lhakhang, the famous fertility temple, followed by a complimentary riverside lunch. Later, return to the hotel & prepare yourself for New Year celebrations, welcoming 2025 in style.

days.title: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour |  Transfer to Paro
days.desc: Start your New Year by exploring Thimphu on a city tour. Marvel at Buddha Dordenma statue at Kuenselphodrang. Next, explore National Memorial Chorten, dedicated to Bhutan’s third king & Royal Textile Museum to learn about Bhutan’s weaving traditions. At Takin Reserve Center, meet Bhutan’s national animal. Don't miss experiencing the lifestyle of the locals at Simply Bhutan & capture the stunning architecture of Tashichho Dzong. Later, get driven to Paro. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.

days.title: Hike to Tiger’s Nest Monastery
days.desc: From the hotel, get driven to Tiger’s Nest parking area to begin your 7 km hike to Taktsang Monastery. As you ascend, enjoy lush pine forests adorned with colourful prayer flags & serene mountain views. Upon arrival, admire the intricate prayer wheels & intricate design of the monastery. Also, check the vibrant murals dedicated to Guru Rinpoche, who brought Buddhism to Bhutan. After your visit, trek downhill and return to the parking area & get driven back to the hotel for overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Phuntsholing via Chelela Pass | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After you check out, get driven to Phuentsholing, taking a detour to Chelela Pass, the highest motorable pass in Bhutan. Here, enjoy stunning views of Mt Jomolhari & Paro Valley. Continue the journey to Phuentsholing. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Later, you may explore the town on your own & visit Bhutan Gate, which serves as an entry point between India and Bhutan or spend some time in peace at Central Park. Later, return to the hotel on your own for overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out of the hotel, you will be driven to the Bhutan Immigration Office. Complete your formalities, after which, you'll be driven to Bagdogra International Airport for your journey back home. This marks the end of your amazing trip to Bhutan.
